headline: Democrats win Congress, Ottawa tables its budget
summary: U.S. midterms flipped Congress to Democrats, raising questions for tariffs and trade with Canada. Ottawa tabled a budget with a $62.3-billion deficit, while Ontario's deficit grew to $16.9 billion and Toronto faces a budget gap.

top.headline: Democrats flip Congress in U.S. midterms
top.what: Democrats are projected to hold at least 259 House and 54 Senate seats, with Alaska and Mississippi Senate races unresolved.
top.why: A Democratic Congress can block tariffs and open investigations, shaping U.S.-Canada trade.

top.headline: Ottawa tables budget with $62.3B deficit
top.what: The budget adds about $142 billion in new spending over five years and projects deficits above $50 billion for four more years.
top.why: It shapes taxes, borrowing costs and housing and immigration policy.

top.headline: Oil swings on Iran talks and Hormuz shipping
top.what: Oil fell on hopes of an Iran breakthrough after limited U.S. strikes.
top.why: Oil prices drive Ontario gas and transport costs.

top.headline: Canada-U.S. trade talks continue as Democrats vow tariff repeal
top.what: Talks continue while incoming Democrats say they will push to repeal tariffs.
top.why: Tariffs affect Ontario manufacturing jobs and prices.

top.headline: Ontario deficit swells to $16.9B
top.what: The fall economic statement pushed the balanced budget further away amid tariffs.
top.why: Provincial finances affect services and taxes.

top.headline: Toronto faces $1.12B shortfall; Ford rules out new deal
top.what: Premier Ford ruled out a new funding deal for Toronto.
top.why: Could mean higher property taxes or service cuts.

top.headline: Trump accepts results but warns of vetoes
top.what: Trump said he was a little surprised; Speaker Johnson is stepping aside as GOP leader.
top.why: Sets up a two-year power struggle in Washington.

top.headline: GTA gas to fall about 7 cents a litre
top.what: Pump prices are expected to hit their lowest since June on Friday.
top.why: Lower fuel costs ease commuting and delivery costs.
